title: Exponential time class normalization
statement: Let $L$ be a language of binary strings, and let $C,c\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose there are natural numbers $K,r$ and a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the binary alphabet that decides $L$ within time $K\bigl(n+C\cdot 2^{(n+1)^c}+1\bigr)^r$. Then $L$ belongs to $\bigcup_{e\in\mathbb{N}}\mathrm{NTIME}(n\mapsto 2^{n^e})$.
hypotheses_covered: Existence of natural numbers $K,r$ and a finite nondeterministic binary machine $N$
$N$ decides $L$ within the stated time bound
replaced: Let $L$ be a language over the binary alphabet and $C, c$ natural numbers. If some nondeterministic machine decides $L$ within time $K(n + C\cdot 2^{(n+1)^c} + 1)^r$ for constants $K, r$, then $L$ belongs to $\bigcup_e \mathrm{NTIME}(2^{n^e})$.
